items.sentence: On [MASK], Complainant filed an EEO complaint alleging that the Agency discriminated against her on the bases of sex (female), disability (physical), and reprisal for prior protected EEO activity under Title VII and the Rehabilitation Act when: 1.
On [MASK], and ongoing, she was denied overtime work within her limitations; 2.
On [MASK], she was verbally abused by a coworker and no action was taken; 2 3.
Beginning on [MASK], and ongoing, she was micromanaged and assigned to either the rewrap section or city manual section and/or confronted about her job duties; and 4.
On [MASK], her request for a temporary change of schedule was denied.
